TIEBA_DIY_EVENT_GOD_OF_DIY.title: God of DIY
TIEBA_DIY_EVENT_GOD_OF_DIY.talk.firstVis: Treasure this well, for you will never see this line again.
TIEBA_DIY_EVENT_GOD_OF_DIY.talk.ANY.0-0r: You must be a very patient person. After all, who has time to read all this dialogue?
TIEBA_DIY_EVENT_GOD_OF_DIY.talk.ANY.1-0r: You like these DIYs too? Great, we're kindred spirits!
TIEBA_DIY_EVENT_GOD_OF_DIY.talk.ANY.2-0r: Folks, I say: folks, I say: folks: I say: folks...
TIEBA_DIY_EVENT_GOD_OF_DIY.talk.ANY.3-0r: Nothing is beyond your imagination—only beyond my ability.
